subject: Commercial proposal: VPC licensing, deferred platform fee & SRE support
messages:
From: Alex Jenkins <alex.jenkins@healthlytics.com>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-12-01T15:02:00-08:00
Subject: Quick: commercial packaging and support for VPC deployment

Hi Kimberly,

Thanks for the overview on the call earlier. I attached our RFP (Healthlytics_RFP.pdf) with the key questions our procurement and infra teams have flagged. High level: we expect a multi-site VPC deployment across two US regions, O(30) licensed nodes initially, and a phased ramp to O(120) over 24 months.

Specific asks:
- Can Redwood amortize the one-time platform fee across a 12- or 24-month term (or allow deferral tied to milestones)?
- Clear pricing per licensed node and how multi-site discounts tier.
- Support tiers: we need a defined SRE retainer (hours / quarter) plus an option for on-call escalation credits.
- SOC 2 / security evidence and acceptable SLAs for response/restore.

Procurement timeline: target signature by 2026-12-15.

Can you send a written commercial structure (line items + optional credits) we can review with finance?

Appreciate it — cc'd procurement@healthlytics.com who will coordinate the docs.

Best,
Alex Jenkins
Director, Infrastructure
Healthlytics

Attachment: Healthlytics_RFP.pdf (pdf, 1 page stub)
From: Kimberly Park <kimberly@redwood.com>
To: Alex Jenkins <alex.jenkins@healthlytics.com>
Cc: procurement@healthlytics.com
Date: 2026-12-02T09:10:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Quick: commercial packaging and support for VPC deployment

Alex — thanks for the RFP and for summarizing the timeline. I pulled together an initial proposal and attached a simple pricing grid (vpc-pricing-grid.xlsx) plus our migration playbook for planning (migration-playbook.pdf).

Top-level option we recommend for Healthlytics (pilot -> scale):
1) Starter Pilot (3 months): 10 licensed nodes, standard platform fee (waived if you convert to committed 12-month deal within 30 days), 2 SRE days included to validate rollout.
2) Committed VPC (12/24 month options): per-node licensing, multi-site discount schedule (5% @ 30 nodes, 10% @ 60, 15% @ 100+), platform fee can be amortized monthly across the commit term.
3) Support: Bronze (business hours), Silver (24/7 async + 8/5 urgent), Gold (24/7 + dedicated SRE retainer). We can include a quarterly SRE block (4 weeks/year) as a paid attachable option or part of Gold.

To address your asks:
- Deferral: we can consider deferring up to 60% of platform fee tied to delivery milestones (pilot acceptance, production cutover).
- SOC2 / evidence: I'll share our SOC2 summary and auditing contact after you confirm NDA status; we can put SOC2 attestation into the SOW.
- SLA: standard published SLAs apply; we can add an uptime floor and response time guarantees in the committed SOW for enterprise purchase.

Next step: are you open to a short 30-min pricing call with Soojin (pricing lead) and David (legal/contracts) tomorrow? If yes I can loop them in and bring a versioned commercial by EOD.

Thanks,
Kimberly Park
Senior Account Executive — Enterprise
Redwood Inference

Attachments: vpc-pricing-grid.xlsx (excel stub), migration-playbook.pdf (pdf stub)
From: Alex Jenkins <alex.jenkins@healthlytics.com>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly@redwood.com>
Cc: procurement@healthlytics.com
Date: 2026-12-02T10:45:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Quick: commercial packaging and support for VPC deployment

Kimberly — appreciate the quick turnaround. A few clarifying points from procurement/infra after a quick read:

- Healthlytics prefers not to pay a large upfront platform fee. Can Redwood offer a structure that puts only a small upfront deposit (<= 20%) and defers the balance across milestones tied to production availability and performance? We can accept an amortization but need the cashflow to match our internal budget windows.
- For SRE: we need guaranteed on-call handoff windows and an option to buy additional SRE weeks at fixed rates — our infra lead wants to avoid open-ended T&M.
- Contract length: we are prepared to commit to a 24-month term if you can provide deeper multi-site discounts and an annual SRE retainer included in the price.

I attached procurement_timeline.xlsx with our internal sign-off cadence. Our target is still 12/15 for signature but flexibility to 12/22 if we get a clean SOW and redlines.

Can Soojin and David join the call? We want pricing and legal to be aligned in the same session.

Thanks — Alex

Attachment: procurement_timeline.xlsx (spreadsheet stub)
From: Kimberly Park <kimberly@redwood.com>
To: Soojin Lee <soojin@redwood.com>, David Kim <david@redwood.com>
Cc: Alex Jenkins <alex.jenkins@healthlytics.com>, procurement@healthlytics.com
Date: 2026-12-03T08:18:00-08:00
Subject: FW: Quick: commercial packaging and support for VPC deployment — approval request + proposed fallbacks

Soojin / David — looping you both in. Healthlytics (high quality prospect; see attached RFP and timeline) asked to minimize upfront platform fee and prefers milestone deferral. They also want a 24-month commitment in exchange for deeper discounts and an annual SRE retainer included.

Proposed commercially fair compromise (what I'll propose on the call unless you flag):
- Platform fee: list = $250,000. Offer structure: 20% upfront ($50k), 60% deferred and amortized across 18 months ($150k), 20% held as milestone credit tied to production SLA windows ($50k) refundable as credits against usage if milestones met.
- Licensing: per-node list at $2,000/month for licensed node; multi-site discounts: 7% @ 30+, 12% @ 60+, 18% @ 100+.
- Support: include a 4-week/year SRE retainer in the 24-month committed package; additional SRE weeks available at fixed rate $9,500/week (pre-negotiated block).
- SOC2 evidence: available; will include attestation and a contractual security addendum in SOW.

Impact / risks: deferred platform fee and milestone credits increase collection risk and recognition complexity; recommends approval for up to 60% deferral with negotiated escrow-like credit schedule. If you prefer, we can require a letter of credit for the deferred portion.

I propose deal_id REDW-7421 be approved for a commercial exception: up to 60% deferral + 4 SRE weeks/year included for a 24-month commit (assuming 2-year minimum ARR threshold met). If approved I'll send the redlined commercial term sheet and a draft SOW (draft-sow-v1.docx) to Healthlytics today.

Can you reply with approvals or changes by EOD so I can proceed?

Thanks,
Kimberly
From: Soojin Lee <soojin@redwood.com>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly@redwood.com>, Alex Jenkins <alex.jenkins@healthlytics.com>
Cc: David Kim <david@redwood.com>, procurement@healthlytics.com
Date: 2026-12-04T09:23:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Quick: commercial packaging and support for VPC deployment — final offer

Kimberly / Alex — thanks everyone for the sync earlier. We can proceed with an exception for Healthlytics under the following confirmed terms (we'll document in SOW + term sheet):

Final commercial summary (REDW-7421):
- Platform fee: $250,000 total. Payment schedule: 20% upfront ($50k), 50% amortized monthly across 18 months ($125k), 30% held as milestone credit to be released based on three production milestones (pilot acceptance, production cutover, first month of stable ops) ($75k). Milestone credits apply as usage credits or invoice offsets per agreement.
- Licensing: $2,000/node/month list; multi-site discounts applied at thresholds: 7% @ 30 nodes, 12% @ 60, 18% @ 100+.
- Support: 4 SRE weeks/year included for the 24-month committed package. Extra SRE weeks available at $9,000/week (pre-paid block pricing).
- Term: 24 months; early termination carries a pro-rated platform fee acceleration clause.
- Security/SLA: SOC2 attestation to be appended; enterprise SLA with uptime and response windows included in the SOW.

Next steps for Healthlytics:
1) Kimberly will share the draft term sheet + draft-sow-v1.docx to procurement and Alex by EOD.
2) Healthlytics to provide final procurement redlines by 2026-12-10.
3) We will prepare DocuSign package (link will be provided) and aim to execute by 2026-12-22.

Soojin Lee
VP, Sales — North America
Redwood Inference

Attachment: draft-sow-v1.docx (docx stub)
